text.p: These are the leading stories in the Sarajevo press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Collective presidency holds five hours of talks on creation of council of ministers, a Bosnian state official says. Meeting will resume on Saturday.

- Michael Steiner, deputy to international High Representative envoy to Bosnia, urges Bosnian Serb government to resolve a dispute over the participation of representatives from Moslem-Croat Federation in the Bosnian Serb assembly.
- International community gave $140,000 less than pledged for Bosnia recontruction, a foreign ministry official says.
- IFOR should hand over control of Sarajevo airport to civilian authorities by December 20, Bosnian Prime Minister Hasan Muratovic says.
- The World Bank may grant $1 million loan to Bosnia for gas expenses, official says. --Sarajevo newsroom, +387-71-663-864.
